scope: Source-level finite-core and exact-complement interface; no Lean or publication claim

partition.rho: A fixed C-infinity nonincreasing cutoff equal to 1 on (-infinity,1], equal to 0 on [2,infinity); on (1,2), rho(x)=b(2-x)/(b(2-x)+b(x-1)), b(y)=exp(-1/y) for y>0 and 0 otherwise
partition.phi: phi(x)=rho(x)-rho(2*x), supported in [1/2,2]; sum_{k>=0} phi(n/2^k)=1 for every integer n>=1
partition.labels: N,R,S,M are 2^k, k>=0; use phi(n/N) phi(r/R) phi(s/S) phi(m/M)
partition.near_labels: Keep (N,R,S) if [N*R*S/8,8*N*R*S] intersects [P^2.9992,P^3.0008]. Keep M if [M/2,2*M] intersects [P^.502,P^.5025].
partition.finite_localization: For D sufficiently large every whole retained n*r*s support is inside [P^2.998,P^3.002]. The artificial hard product localization is identically one there and is removed before Poisson.
partition.far_labels: All other labels belong to the already paid scalar nonresonant tails; they are not silently included in core or dropped without that accepted estimate.

exact_core_criterion.selection: Both inequalities on whole-polynomial maximum lengths; common label selection independent of p, psi and individual summands.
exact_core_criterion.upper_margin: Both final lengths <=P^(2-13*kappa/8), hence <=floor(P^2) eventually; any cutoff below 1 means its whole transform was paid as a Fourier tail.

decomposition.original_left: I_left is the original good-family safe-left mean with the actual -i*B_beta^(-1)*Z_psi^2*Z_chipsi scalar, actual gamma factors, actual a*Mcal normalizer and Gaussian
decomposition.safe_regrouping: c_X=conjugate(eta_beta3)*nu_[1,X] on Re(s)=-1/2 before localization or central-line shift
decomposition.core: All near labels satisfying both exact_core_criterion inequalities; after three true Poisson completions keep both signs, exact i^(2a+b), inherited Gamma/B_beta scalar, and common dual cutoffs; replace c_X by chi*power_(-beta3) only here
decomposition.D3_convention: In C3_psi*conjugate(D3_psi), D3 coefficients are chi*power_(+beta3), where power_gamma(n)=n^(-gamma)
decomposition.complement: All near labels failing at least one core inequality, with original c_X; no global S_infinity replacement
decomposition.tails: Original safe infinite scalar tails, far-label tails and core dual Fourier tails are separate paid errors, not part of the complement main; optional long-pure removal must be stated with its own paid error and otherwise those labels stay in complement
decomposition.comparison_error: O(a^(-1)*L^(-623/4))+O(a^(-1)*P^(-10)) under the accepted source review
decomposition.target: Re(core+complement) <= (1-epsilon)*m_H+o(1), fixed epsilon>0, without changing original assumption exponent -2022 or final target 2024
